cases.assertion: An owned authorized upload yields alt text and topic suggestions. The user confirms the selection before applying the draft update or publishing.
Another account's media ID cannot be used for description or metadata update and triggers no inference.
An arbitrary URL is rejected before storage or inference.
An authorized public post's public images enter vision moderation and are rechecked before the saved advice is exposed.
A text-only moderation model receives no images and the client marks the analysis scope as text only.
